title: Decisions that need two conditions
objective: Use AND inside IF so that a decision is made only when every condition is true.
instructions: In G2:G6 show "Reorder" only when stock on hand is below the reorder point AND the status is not "Discontinued"; otherwise show "Hold". In H2:H6 show "Star" only when the margin is above the margin target in B8 AND the sell-through is above the target in B9; otherwise show "Review".
hints: AND(test1, test2) is TRUE only when both tests are TRUE. Put it inside IF as the condition.
For G2: =IF(AND(B2<C2,D2<>"Discontinued"),"Reorder","Hold"). <> means not equal to.
For H2 point at the target cells with dollar locks: =IF(AND(E2>$B$8,F2>$B$9),"Star","Review"). Above a target means >, not >=.
